evidence.reason: The registry contains the twelve specified output entries; ONCHAIN_REGISTRY_VERSION is 1.0.0 at line 33 and the derived feature tuple is built at lines 183-185. The aggregation, raw, scale, release, window, and minimum-history values match the fixed v1 registry entries through line 181.

The test verifies twelve entries, unique ff_oc_* names, and version 1.0.0. A wrong individual registry field would be a realistic untested failure mode, but manual inspection of the checked-in entries found no such mismatch.

The metric is selected from the second CSV column, while the asset is selected only from the fixed Bitcoin/Ethereum filename prefix at lines 33-37. UTC parsing, two-column validation, duplicate/increasing timestamps, finite values, complete source grid, and the required error tokens are implemented at lines 39-84.

Required duplicate, non-finite, missing-source, unsupported-asset, and non-Funding-gap rejection cases are exercised at lines 72-117. A malformed date or empty CSV is not covered and may produce a parser/index error rather than an audit token, but that is outside the listed mutation cases.

Funding is reindexed to a 15-minute grid and forward-filled with the integer eight-hour limit of 32 rows; unresolved leading or over-limit gaps fail closed at lines 103-106. The audit records imputed rows, first/last missing timestamps, and the configured maximum staleness at lines 108-117.

The 25-row carry is asserted to use the prior value only, and the over-eight-hour and leading-gap cases fail at lines 130-134 and 223-228. No bfill, interpolation, or zero fill appears in the production module.

Every non-Funding hourly series is rejected when any resample bucket has a count other than four. The real checked-in source starts at 20:30 UTC (data/Onchain-Data/Bitcoin (BTC) 15min-Age Consumed.csv:2) and ends at 20:15 UTC (same file:94273), so its first and last hourly buckets are partial and build_symbol_feature_frame fails before producing features.

Aggregation and release tests use an hour-aligned fixture beginning at 00:00 and therefore do not exercise the real 20:30/20:15 boundaries. Suffix invariance is only demonstrated for that aligned fixture at lines 161-172.

transform_metric correctly makes zero centered/zero-anchored scales NaN at lines 229 and 239, but build_symbol_feature_frame unconditionally forward-fills every feature column. After a valid history followed by a long constant or zero-scale interval, the required NaN is replaced by a stale prior feature value.
The constant-series test starts with no prior valid feature and tests transform_metric directly; it cannot detect post-warm-up NaNs being overwritten by the final frame builder.

checks.evidence: The real source cadence makes the non-Funding aggregation path fail on partial boundary buckets at gpu_fuzzy_trader/data/onchain_pipeline.py:124-129, and the final frame builder violates the zero-scale-NaN contract at gpu_fuzzy_trader/data/onchain_pipeline.py:274-275.

The deterministic package reports 25 targeted tests passing, but tests/unit/test_onchain_pipeline.py:145-150 uses an hour-aligned synthetic source and tests/unit/test_onchain_pipeline.py:207-210 does not pass through build_symbol_feature_frame. The suite therefore misses both production failures.

The commit changes only the four files listed in the task package. Graph inbound tracing finds only the new unit tests as current callers; the package reports no direct production dependents. The future unit-2/unit-3 consumers remain unimplemented and must not rely on the currently failing real-source path.

findings.title: Real intraday source cannot be aggregated
findings.description: The implementation requires four observations in every hourly resample bucket for non-Funding metrics. The supplied source snapshot is phase-shifted to 20:30 through 20:15 UTC, so the first and last buckets are partial. load_and_audit_sources accepts this valid 15-minute grid, but build_symbol_feature_frame then raises unexpected timestamp gap for every non-Funding metric. Handle or deliberately discard incomplete boundary buckets before enforcing the four-observation rule, and add a test using the real source phase.

findings.title: Frame builder erases zero-scale NaNs
findings.description: The transform contract requires zero-scale results to remain NaN. The builder forward-fills all feature columns after merging availability rows, so a NaN after a previously valid value becomes a stale finite value. Test a post-warm-up constant/zero-scale interval through build_symbol_feature_frame and preserve semantic NaNs while only filling structural release-alignment gaps.

findings.title: Targeted tests do not cover the production source shape
findings.description: The aggregation fixtures begin at 00:00 and the constant test stops at transform_metric. This test shape permits both production defects above to pass the reported 25-test verification. Add boundary-phase and final-frame regression tests.

notes: Registry, audit mutation cases, funding carry, and aligned aggregation math are otherwise consistent with the stated contract. Review is blocked by the real-source aggregation failure and the final-frame NaN masking.
